title: Three Seasons and One Short Staff
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：mineral　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mineral 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the ranger ① dug the mineral that no villager in the valley would have described, and he said the digging was the whole of the season. The ② mineral, meaning the stone itself and not the staff, ran three seasons and stayed undescribed in the book; a mineral, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ mineral in that valley had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ mineral at the far ridge, meaning the track they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A mineral, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the ranger said the describing is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mineral was the whole of the matter, meaning the wealth and not the stone. The ⑥ mineral, meaning the wealth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; mineral, he said, is either something you dig or the only word that means both a stone and a wealth. He said the wealth is the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ mineral had become a line in a survey, and the survey had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ mineral of the whole thing, the ranger wrote in October, was one valley and three seasons of describing; mineral, he said, is either the track at the far ridge or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mineral I remember is the stone described in the survey, which closed in 1965 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ mineral, my mother said in 1967, is the only stone that improves by being described; every mineral, she said, is a wealth that has agreed to look like a stone. She said the wealth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 矿物；矿物质（指山谷里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 矿物；矿物质（指那种矿物本身，与短短的手杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：dig the mineral 开采这一种矿物
D. n. 矿物；矿物质（指留给孩子们循的那一条）
E. n. 矿物之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的矿物之事）
F. n. 矿物；矿物质（指踏勘记录里写到、被描述的那一种）
G. n. 矿物、富藏（指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 富藏（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: dug the mineral that no villager in the valley would have described
The mineral, meaning the stone itself and not the staff
the mineral at the far ridge
the mineral was the whole of the matter
the mineral had become a line in a survey
The mineral of the whole thing
A mineral, my mother said in 1967

answers.why: dig the mineral 意为“开采这一种矿物”，1958 年那位守林人把山谷里没有一位村民肯描述的一种矿物做了一遍。
mineral 意为“矿物；矿物质”，指那种矿物本身而不是短短的手杖，它经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被描述。
mineral 意为“矿物；矿物质”，指山谷里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。
mineral 意为“矿物；矿物质”，指最远那道山脊的留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mineral 意为“矿物、富藏”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种富藏就是那件事的全部。
mineral 意为“富藏”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种矿物，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mineral 意为“矿物；矿物质”，指踏勘记录里写到、被描述的那一种，到 1963 年这一种成了踏勘记录里的一行。
mineral 意为“矿物之事”，守林人十月写道，整件事的矿物之事是一处山谷和三个季节的描述。
mineral 意为“矿物；矿物质”，我记得的是踏勘记录里描述过的那一种，1965 年走遍了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一种。
mineral 为抽象总称，母亲 1967 年说，矿物是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的矿物。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年那位守林人开采了山谷里没有一位村民肯描述的一种矿物，他说这一遍才是那个季节的全部。（dig the mineral）
那种矿物，指的是那种矿物本身而不是短短的手杖，经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被描述。（mineral）
那处山谷里每一种矿物旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。（mineral）
最远那道山脊那种矿物，指的是他们留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（mineral）
叔叔说这种富藏就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那种矿物。（mineral）
1967 年母亲说，矿物是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的矿物。（mineral）

The mineral at the far ridge, meaning the track they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
